Name: Living Planetoid, Lesser
Information:
**Living Planetoid**

A hungry juggernaut that drifts through the cosmos, devouring anything substantial enough to cross its path. These elementals often form from the remains of planets destroyed by the Cosmic Teardrop, imbuing life into the shards that remain. Alternatively, chunks of space debris that carry a connection to the Elemental Planes may accidentally bleed life into them, causing them to come alive, confused and hungry.

Information Sections.Text: I’ll admit to having nightmares about my own home, a hollowed out planet I stumbled upon, coming to life. Mostly because I do bring back increasingly supernatural trophies and one day one is bound to have unintended consequences.

traits.name: Gravity Horizon
traits.description:
The planetoid can adjust all gravity within 300 feet of it. At the start of each of its turns, it can choose to turn this area into regular gravity, a low-gravity environment, or a zero-gravity environment.

When a creature attempts to leave the area of the planetoid’s Gravity Horizon, it may force them to make a DC 21 Strength saving throw. On a failure, they are immediately pulled toward it by 100 feet plus their remaining movement and cannot take any more movement until the end of their turn. If pulled into the air, they are suspended in place until the start of their next turn, even if the area is not a low- or zero-gravity environment.

actions.name: Debris Crash
actions.description: The planetoid chooses up to three targets within 120 feet of itself, and hurls orbiting debris at them as a Ranged Weapon Attack: +13 to hit. Hit: 29 (4d10 + 7) bludgeoning damage. Each creature this hits who is Large or smaller is knocked prone.

actions.name: Planetary Bite
actions.description: Macro Melee Weapon Attack: +13 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit: 29 (4d10 + 7) piercing damage plus 22 (4d10) force damage (macro: 47 piercing, 40 force). If the attack exceeds the target’s armor class by 10 points or more, they are automatically grappled and restrained (escape DC 21).

actions.name: Expel Core Bursts (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: The planetoid chooses three points it can see within 480 feet and launches a molten burst at each, where they explode in a 40-foot-radius sphere of molten energy. Each creature in any of these spaces must make a DC 21 Dexterity saving throw (macro), taking 43 (6d10 + 10) fire damage on a failure, or half as much damage on a success. (macro: 70 fire).

legendary_actions.name: Seize Gravity
legendary_actions.description: The planetoid chooses one creature within 800 feet of it, forcing them to make a DC 21 Strength saving throw. If the target fails while outside its Gravity Horizon, the target is pulled up to 400 feet toward it. If it fails while inside the Gravity Horizon, the target’s movement speed is reduced to 0 until the end of the planetoid’s next turn.

legendary_actions.name: Debris Slam (Costs 2 Actions)
legendary_actions.description: The planetoid uses its Debris Crash action, but its range is extended to 480 feet.

legendary_actions.name: Create Debris Storm (Costs 3 Actions)
legendary_actions.description: The planetoid creates an active debris field around itself with a density of 1d6 + 2, which fills its Gravity Horizon. The planetoid is immune to its own debris field and may pass through it harmlessly. It immediately rolls a random Debris Event, which happens to every creature inside it. This field disappears at the end of the planetoid’s next turn.
